newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM's Rauma retail offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: UPM's Rauma retail offer oversubscribed.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group industry group UPM-Kymmene said in a statement on Tuesday its offering of shares in engineering group Rauma to retail investors had been five times oversubscribed.
UPM said it had decided to raise the stake sold to retail investors to 990,000 shares.
"Demand in the Rauma retail offering exceeded by more than five times the initially offered 300,000 shares," UPM said.

In its offerings to institutional and retail investors UPM sold a total of 13.07 million Rauma shares, of which 31 percent were sold in Finland and other Nordic countires, and 27 percent in North-America.
In addition, Rauma bought one million of its own shares from UPM-Kymmene and cancelled them.
